chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn 'Abd Allah ibn Quda'ah al-Safwani.

key_terms.أَحْمَدَ: The name Ahmad, identified as Muhammad's father.
key_terms.الصَّفْوَانِيُّ: Al-Safwani, the nisbah identifying the person.
key_terms.عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: The name 'Abd Allah in the lineage.
key_terms.قُضَاعَةَ: Quda'ah, an ancestor in the lineage.

ai.seo_question: Who is Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn 'Abd Allah ibn Quda'ah al-Safwani in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This text is a biographical entry naming Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn 'Abd Allah ibn Quda'ah al-Safwani. It does not contain a hadith matn or a narrator chain, but rather identifies a person among the shaykhs mentioned in the chapter.
